interface.signature: def findHeight(N: int, arr: list[int]) -> int:

preconditions.description: N is the number of nodes in the binary tree and must be between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(arr) == N and all(-1 <= x <= 10**5 for x in arr)
preconditions.description: arr is a list of length N where each element is a parent index (0 ≤ arr[i] ≤ 10^5) or -1 for the root.
arr contains exactly one -1, representing the root node.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(0, max(0 if arr[i] == -1 else 1 + findHeight(N, [arr[j] for j in range(N) if arr[j] == i]) for i in range(N)))
postconditions.description: The function returns the height of the binary tree, defined as the maximum depth from the root to any leaf node. The height is computed recursively by finding the maximum height among all subtrees.
